description: preparenovonix cleans and augments data files produced by Novonix battery testers. BatLab Lancaster provides Python functions that handle format differences, extract named columns and add information for coulombic counting or identifying experimental protocol stages. A master function allows selected preparation steps to be combined. Spatial coverage is not geographically fixed, and sampling intervals and test durations follow the battery experiments. Prepared measurements can support calibration and comparison of related battery models for electricity storage and electric vehicles. Code is free under MIT, with NumPy required and optional MATLAB integration documented. The README lists the Novonix software versions tested by the authors and provides an example comparison plot. A limitation is that unlisted instrument software versions may use different file conventions and need separate checks. The package does not supply a battery degradation model. No experimental files were downloaded, overwritten or processed.
name: preparenovonix battery test data preparation
